questions.question_english: If an employee submits a ‘Technical Resignation’, what is the impact on their qualifying service for pension under OPS?

Past service counts towards pension if both posts are covered under pension rules.

questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 26(2) of the CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972 / Rule 26 of the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021, a Technical Resignation carries specific statutory immunities regarding qualifying service:

1. No Forfeiture of Service: Unlike a standard resignation which completely extinguishes all past service, a technical resignation explicitly shields the employee from forfeiture of qualifying service.
2. Continuity of Pensionable Service: The past service rendered in the previous department or ministry is counted towards qualifying service for both monthly pension and retirement/death gratuity, provided that both the earlier post and the subsequent post are covered under statutory pension rules (e.g., CCS Pension Rules or matching reciprocal arrangements).
3. Administrative Requisites: The service book and pension records of the employee are transferred to the new department, ensuring unbroken service records, leave balance carries forward, and calculation of qualifying service remains continuous.

केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (पेंशन) नियम, 2021 के नियम 26 (तथा 1972 नियमों के नियम 26(2)) के अंतर्गत, तकनीकी त्यागपत्र (Technical Resignation) अर्हक सेवा के संबंध में पूर्ण सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है:

1. सेवा की जब्ती नहीं: सामान्य त्यागपत्र के विपरीत जहाँ कर्मचारी की पुरानी सेवा समाप्त मानी जाती है, तकनीकी त्यागपत्र में पिछली अर्हक सेवा की कोई जब्ती (Forfeiture) नहीं होती।
2. पेंशन हेतु निरंतरता: पुराने पद पर की गई सेवा नए पद पर मासिक पेंशन और सेवानिवृत्ति/मृत्यु उपदान दोनों के लिए अर्हक सेवा के रूप में गिनी जाती है, बशर्ते कि पूर्व पद और नवीन पद दोनों ही वैधानिक पेंशन नियमों (जैसे CCS पेंशन नियम या पारस्परिक पेंशन व्यवस्था) के अंतर्गत आते हों।
3. सेवा पुस्तिका का स्थानांतरण: कर्मचारी की सेवा पुस्तिका और अवकाश खाते को नए कार्यालय में स्थानांतरित कर दिया जाता है, जिससे सेवा में व्यवधान नहीं माना जाता और पेंशन लाभों के लिए निरंतरता बनी रहती है।

questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 21 of the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021 and Rule 59 of the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972, all leave during service for which leave salary is payable counts as qualifying service. Specifically, study leave sanctioned to a government servant under CCS (Leave) Rules counts in full as active qualifying service for pension and retirement gratuity calculations, provided the employee successfully completes the approved course of study, returns to duty, and satisfies all service bond conditions required by the administration. No penalty or service reduction is applied. Hence, option D is correct.

Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Ad-hoc service rendered by a government servant prior to regular appointment generally does not count as qualifying service for pension under the CCS (Pension) Rules.
Reason (R): Ad-hoc appointments are stop-gap arrangements made de hors regular recruitment rules, and statutory pension rules require service to be rendered in a substantive capacity or continuous temporary service followed by confirmation without interruption.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct option:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english:
The counting of pre-regularization service for pensionary benefits is governed by Rules 13, 14, and 15 of the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 2021 and established administrative law principles.

Legal and Statutory Analysis:
1. Assertion (A) is TRUE: As a general rule of civil service jurisprudence, ad-hoc service rendered prior to regular appointment does not count as qualifying service for pension. Ad-hoc appointees do not hold a civil post substantively, nor are they selected through the statutory recruitment process (such as UPSC or DSSSB).
2. Reason (R) is TRUE: Under Rule 14 of the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021, the service of a government servant does not qualify for pension unless it conforms to three statutory conditions:
   (a) The service must be under the government;
   (b) The employment must be in a substantive, temporary, or officiating capacity; and
   (c) The service must be followed without interruption by substantive appointment or confirmation in the same or another post.
   Ad-hoc appointments are purely stop-gap arrangements made de hors the statutory recruitment rules. They confer no seniority, promotion claims, or pensionary weightage.
3. Relationship: Because ad-hoc appointments lack regular selection, statutory sanction, and substantive status, they fail the mandatory test of Rule 14. Therefore, Reason (R) directly and correctly explains why Assertion (A) is legally sound.

पेंशन लाभों के लिए नियमितीकरण से पूर्व की सेवा की गणना सीसीएस (पेंशन) नियम, 2021 के नियम 13, 14 और 15 तथा प्रशासनिक कानून के सिद्धांतों द्वारा नियंत्रित होती है।

विधिक एवं सांविधिक विश्लेषण:
1. अभिकथन (A) सही है: प्रशासनिक विधि के सामान्य नियम के रूप में, नियमित नियुक्ति से पूर्व की गई तदर्थ (Ad-hoc) सेवा पेंशन के लिए अर्हक सेवा के रूप में नहीं गिनी जाती। तदर्थ कर्मचारी नियमित भर्ती नियमों (जैसे UPSC या DSSSB चयन) के तहत चयनित नहीं होते हैं और वे पद पर कोई स्थायी अधिकार नहीं रखते।
2. कारण (R) सही है: सीसीएस (पेंशन) नियम, 2021 के नियम 14 के अनुसार, सरकारी सेवा केवल तभी पेंशन हेतु अर्हक होती है जब वह तीन शर्तों को पूरा करे:
   (क) सेवा सरकार के अधीन की गई हो;
   (ख) रोजगार मूल (Substantive), अस्थायी (Temporary), या स्थानापन्न (Officiating) क्षमता में हो; तथा
   (ग) उस सेवा के बाद बिना किसी व्यवधान के उसी या किसी अन्य पद पर नियमित नियुक्ति या संपुष्टि (Confirmation) हुई हो।
   चूंकि तदर्थ नियुक्तियां भर्ती नियमों से परे (de hors rules) केवल तदर्थ/कामचलाऊ व्यवस्था होती हैं, वे नियम 14 की शर्तों को पूरा नहीं करती हैं।
3. व्याख्या का संबंध: चूंकि तदर्थ नियुक्तियां सांविधिक भर्ती नियमों के अनुसार नहीं की जाती हैं और उनमें सेवा की निरंतरता का नियमित विधिक दर्जा नहीं होता, इसलिए वे अर्हक सेवा में नहीं जुड़तीं। अतः कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की बिल्कुल सही और तर्कसंगत व्याख्या करता है।

Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): The National Pension System (NPS) was made mandatory for all new recruits to the Central Government civil services and posts (except Armed Forces) joining on or after January 1, 2004.
Reason (R): The Government of India decided to transfer the entire financial burden and liability of central government pensions to state governments for future appointments.
In the context of the statements above, which of the following is correct?
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is completely false. Vide Ministry of Finance Notification No. 5/7/2003-ECB & PR dated December 22, 2003, the Government of India introduced the National Pension System (NPS) on a mandatory basis for all new entrants to Central Government service (except the Armed Forces) joining on or after January 1, 2004. The primary objective and rationale was fiscal sustainability: the unfunded, non-contributory defined-benefit Old Pension Scheme (OPS) was creating an unsustainable long-term burden on the Consolidated Fund of India. NPS transitioned government retirement benefits into a transparent, funded, market-linked defined-contribution system. The Central Government did NOT transfer its pension liabilities to state governments; rather, state governments independently enacted their own notifications to adopt NPS for their respective state employees.
questions.explanation_hindi: अभिकथन (A) सही है, किंतु कारण (R) असत्य है। वित्त मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना दिनांक 22 दिसंबर, 2003 के माध्यम से 1 जनवरी, 2004 से सशस्त्र बलों को छोड़कर केंद्र सरकार के सभी नए कर्मचारियों के लिए राष्ट्रीय पेंशन प्रणाली (NPS) अनिवार्य रूप से लागू की गई थी। एनपीएस लागू करने का वास्तविक कारण केंद्र सरकार के बढ़ते राजकोषीय घाटे को नियंत्रित करना और पुरानी अनिधिक (unfunded) परिभाषित लाभ पेंशन के स्थान पर एक वित्तीय रूप से संधारणीय (sustainable) परिभाषित अंशदान मॉडल अपनाना था। केंद्र सरकार ने अपने कर्मचारियों का पेंशन दायित्व राज्य सरकारों पर नहीं डाला; बल्कि राज्य सरकारों ने बाद में स्वेच्छा से अपने-अपने कर्मचारियों के लिए एनपीएस अपनाया। अतः A सही है परंतु R गलत है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A is true but R is false

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The National Pension System was made mandatory for all central government employees joining on or after January 1, 2004, excluding armed forces personnel. However, the reason for this implementation was to manage fiscal pension liabilities and move to a defined contribution model, not to transfer financial burdens of central appointments to state governments.

Under Rule 8 of the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 2021 (Pension subject to future good conduct):
1. **Implied Statutory Condition:** Future good conduct is an implied condition of every grant of pension and its continuance under the CCS Pension Rules.
2. **Presidential Authority:** The President of India (or the appointing authority) has the absolute statutory right to withhold or withdraw a pension or gratuity, or any part thereof, whether permanently or for a specified period, if the pensioner is convicted of a serious crime or found guilty of grave misconduct.
3. **Judicial Conviction:** When the order is based on a conviction by a competent court of law for a serious crime (involving moral turpitude, corruption, or offenses punishable with rigorous imprisonment), a formal departmental departmental inquiry under Rule 14 of CCS (CCA) Rules is not necessary; an administrative show-cause notice suffices.
4. **Compassionate Allowance:** If the pension is wholly withdrawn, the authority competent to withdraw it may sanction a compassionate allowance not exceeding two-thirds of the admissible pension if the case warrants sympathetic consideration.
questions.explanation_hindi:
केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (पेंशन) नियम, 2021 के नियम 8 (भविष्य में अच्छा आचरण पेंशन की पूर्व शर्त) के अनुसार:
1. **वैधानिक शर्त:** भविष्य में अच्छा आचरण बनाए रखना प्रत्येक पेंशन की स्वीकृति और उसके जारी रहने की एक अंतर्निहित शर्त है।
2. **राष्ट्रपति का अधिकार:** यदि किसी पेंशनभोगी को न्यायालय द्वारा किसी गंभीर अपराध का दोषी ठहराया जाता है या वह गंभीर कदाचार का दोषी पाया जाता है, तो भारत के राष्ट्रपति को यह अधिकार है कि वे पेंशन अथवा उपदान को, पूर्णतः या उसके किसी अंश को, स्थायी रूप से अथवा किसी विनिर्दिष्ट अवधि के लिए रोक (withhold) सकते हैं या वापस (withdraw) ले सकते हैं।
3. **न्यायालय द्वारा दोषसिद्धि:** जब कार्रवाई सक्षम न्यायालय की दोषसिद्धि पर आधारित होती है, तो अलग से पूर्ण विभागीय जांच की आवश्यकता नहीं होती; केवल एक कारण बताओ नोटिस देना पर्याप्त होता है।
4. **अनुकंपा भत्ता (Compassionate Allowance):** यदि पेंशन पूर्णतः समाप्त कर दी जाती है, तो सक्षम प्राधिकारी विशेष दया के मामलों में देय पेंशन के दो-तिहाई से अनधिक अनुकंपा भत्ता स्वीकृत कर सकते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Withhold or withdraw pension in full or part, permanently or for a specified period.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: If a pensioner is convicted of a serious crime by a court of law post-retirement, the President of India has statutory authority under CCS Pension Rules to order the withholding or withdrawal of pension, either in full or in part, and either permanently or for a specified fixed duration.

questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 10A of the Central Civil Services (Commutation of Pension) Rules, 1981, which was incorporated following the landmark judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the 'Common Cause' case (1986), the commuted portion of pension is restored automatically after the expiry of fifteen (15) years from the date of commutation. The 15-year period is reckoned from the date on which the commuted value of pension is credited to the pensioner's bank account (or from the date of retirement if commutation is paid concurrently with superannuation). After the completion of 15 years, the pensioner resumes receiving their full, unreduced 100% basic monthly pension, and no further recovery of the commuted amount is made by the Government. Pension disbursing authorities (such as banks and CPPC) are legally mandated to restore the full pension automatically without requiring a fresh application from the pensioner.
questions.explanation_hindi: केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (पेंशन का संराशीकरण) नियम, 1981 के नियम 10A के अनुसार, जो माननीय सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के ऐतिहासिक 'कॉमन कॉज' वाद (1986) के निर्णय के बाद जोड़ा गया था, पेंशन का संराशीकृत भाग संराशीकरण की वास्तविक तिथि से 15 वर्ष (Fifteen years) पूर्ण होने पर स्वतः बहाल (Restore) हो जाता है। यह 15 वर्ष की अवधि उस तिथि से गिनी जाती है जिस दिन संराशीकृत राशि पेंशनभोगी के बैंक खाते में जमा होती है। 15 वर्ष पूरे होते ही पेंशनभोगी को उसकी पूरी (100%) मूल मासिक पेंशन पुनः मिलने लगती है और सरकार द्वारा मासिक कटौती बंद कर दी जाती है। पेंशन संवितरण प्राधिकारियों (बैंकों एवं CPPC) को यह निर्देश है कि 15 वर्ष पूर्ण होने पर बिना पेंशनर द्वारा कोई नया आवेदन दिए पूर्ण पेंशन स्वतः बहाल की जाए।

Once fifteen years elapse, the pensioner receives their full, uncommuted gross basic monthly pension, along with all applicable dearness relief calculated on the full pension amount.

questions.question_english: What is the minimum mandatory monthly subscription rate payable to the General Provident Fund (GPF) by an eligible subscriber under the GPF (Central Services) Rules, 1960?

questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 8(1)(b) of the General Provident Fund (Central Services) Rules, 1960:
1. Minimum Subscription Rate: The monthly subscription to the GPF shall not be less than 6% (six percent) of the subscriber's emoluments. Emoluments for this purpose mean basic pay drawn on the 31st March of the preceding financial year (or on the date of joining service if joined during the year).
2. Maximum Limit: A subscriber may voluntarily choose to subscribe a higher amount up to 100% of their monthly emoluments. However, vide Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare (DoP&PW) OM dated 15.06.2022, an upper ceiling of ₹5 Lakh per financial year has been imposed on the total GPF subscription.
3. Regularity: The subscription is deducted monthly from the pay bill by the DDO, except during periods of suspension (where it is optional) or during the last 3 months prior to retirement (where stoppage is mandatory).
questions.explanation_hindi:
सामान्य भविष्य निधि (केंद्रीय सेवाएं) नियम, 1960 के नियम 8(1)(b) के अनुसार:
1. न्यूनतम अंशदान दर: GPF में मासिक अंशदान की राशि अभिदाता की परिलब्धियों (emoluments) के 6% से कम नहीं होनी चाहिए। परिलब्धियों की गणना पूर्ववर्ती वित्तीय वर्ष के 31 मार्च को आहरित मूल वेतन के आधार पर की जाती है।
2. अधिकतम सीमा: अभिदाता स्वेच्छा से अपनी परिलब्धियों के 100% तक कोई भी अधिक राशि अंशदान के रूप में दे सकता है। तथापि, पेंशन एवं पेंशनभोगी कल्याण विभाग (DoP&PW) के 15.06.2022 के कार्यालय ज्ञापन के अनुसार एक वित्तीय वर्ष में कुल GPF अंशदान की अधिकतम सीमा ₹5 लाख निर्धारित की गई है।
3. नियमितता: DDO द्वारा प्रतिमाह वेतन बिल से यह कटौती की जाती है, केवल निलंबन अवधि (वैकल्पिक) और सेवानिवृत्ति से ठीक पहले के 3 महीनों (अनिवार्य रोक) को छोड़कर।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under the General Provident Fund (Central Services) Rules, 1960, a subscriber must contribute a mandatory minimum monthly subscription rate of six percent of their basic pay and emoluments. Subscribers may voluntarily choose to subscribe a higher percentage, up to a maximum equal to their total monthly basic pay.

questions.question_english: Identify the correct sequential escalation for an unresolved pension grievance of a retired Delhi Government school teacher:

questions.explanation_english:
In government administrative procedure (including Delhi Government schools and Central Government establishments):
1. Primary Level (Head of Office): The pension sanction process originates with the Head of Office (HOO / School Principal / DDO) where the teacher last served. Any discrepancy in service verification, qualifying service, or pension paperwork must first be addressed to the HOO.
2. Accounting Level (Pay & Accounts Office): If the grievance pertains to pension authorization, computation checks, or issue of the Pension Payment Order (PPO), it escalates to the concerned Pay & Accounts Office (PAO).
3. Centralized Escalation (CPENGRAMS): If the issue remains unresolved through direct administrative correspondence, the retiree lodges a formal grievance on CPENGRAMS (Centralized Pension Grievance Redress and Monitoring System, managed by DoPPW), which triggers monitored, time-bound escalation to administrative nodal officers.
Judicial forums like the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) can only be approached after exhausting available administrative remedies.

questions.explanation_hindi:
सरकारी प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया (जिसमें दिल्ली सरकार के विद्यालय और केंद्र सरकार के कार्यालय शामिल हैं) के अनुसार:

3. केंद्रीकृत निवारण पोर्टल (CPENGRAMS): यदि प्रशासनिक पत्राचार से शिकायत का निवारण नहीं होता है, तो पेंशनभोगी भारत सरकार के केंद्रीकृत पेंशन शिकायत निवारण और निगरानी प्रणाली (CPENGRAMS) पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन शिकायत दर्ज करता है, जहां से उच्चाधिकारियों द्वारा समयबद्ध निगरानी की जाती है।

questions.question_english: What is the role of the ‘Trustee Bank’ in the NPS architecture?
options_english: It directly invests and manages subscriber funds into equity and government debt markets.
It disburses monthly annuity payments directly to retired government subscribers.
Receives funds from DDOs/PAOs and transfers them to PFMs as per CRA directions.
It maintains physical service books and official pension files of all government servants.
questions.explanation_english:
In the institutional architecture of the National Pension System (NPS) regulated by PFRDA, the Trustee Bank acts as the banking and clearing arm of the NPS Trust:

1. Collection of Funds: The Trustee Bank receives the monthly NPS contribution funds uploaded and remitted online by Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs), Pay and Accounts Offices (PAOs), and other nodal offices.
2. Fund Settlement & Allocation: Based on daily fund reconciliation files and instructions generated by the Central Recordkeeping Agency (CRA), the Trustee Bank aggregates these remittances and transfers the money to the respective bank accounts of the registered Pension Fund Managers (PFMs) according to the investment allocations of the subscribers.
3. Outflow Management: During withdrawals, partial withdrawals, or final exits, the Trustee Bank receives redemption funds from PFMs and routes them to subscribers' bank accounts or to Annuity Service Providers (ASPs).

Investment decisions are made by PFMs, records are kept by CRAs, and life annuities are managed by ASPs—the Trustee Bank is purely the financial conduit/clearing house.
questions.explanation_hindi:
पेंशन निधि विनियामक और विकास प्राधिकरण (PFRDA) द्वारा विनियमित राष्ट्रीय पेंशन प्रणाली (NPS) के संस्थागत ढांचे में 'ट्रस्टी बैंक' (वर्तमान में एक्सिस बैंक, पूर्व में एसबीआई) एनपीएस ट्रस्ट के बैंकिंग और वित्तीय समाशोधन (Clearing House) विंग के रूप में कार्य करता है:

1. अंशदान संग्रहण: आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDOs), वेतन एवं लेखा कार्यालय (PAOs) तथा अन्य नोडल कार्यालय कर्मचारियों के वेतन से काटी गई मासिक अंशदान राशि को ट्रस्टी बैंक के खाते में प्रेषित करते हैं।
2. निधियों का हस्तांतरण: केंद्रीय अभिलेखपाल अभिकरण (CRA) द्वारा तैयार किए गए दैनिक मिलान और आवंटन निर्देशों के आधार पर, ट्रस्टी बैंक प्राप्त धनराशि को विभिन्न पंजीकृत पेंशन निधि प्रबंधकों (PFMs) के खातों में उनके निर्धारित आनुपातिक निवेश आवंटन के अनुसार हस्तांतरित करता है।
3. निकासी प्रबंधन: सेवानिवृत्ति, आंशिक निकासी या निकास के समय ट्रस्टी बैंक PFMs से मोचित (Redeemed) धनराशि प्राप्त कर अभिदाताओं के बैंक खातों या वार्षिकी सेवा प्रदाताओं (ASPs) को अंतरित करता है।

अतः ट्रस्टी बैंक की मुख्य भूमिका नोडल अधिकारियों से धन प्राप्त कर CRA के निर्देशानुसार PFMs को हस्तांतरित करने की है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Receives funds from DDOs/PAOs and transfers them to PFMs as per CRA directions.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: transfers them to PFMs as per CRA directions. In the National Pension System architecture, the designated Trustee Bank functions as the financial clearing house. questions.question_english: A government teacher’s service book indicates an interruption of two days between two temporary appointments in different government schools. If the competent authority formally condones this break in service under the pension rules, what is the effect on qualifying service?
options_english: The 2 days of service gap are automatically regularized and fully counted as active duty period
The teacher is granted extraordinary leave without pay for 2 days to maintain continuous duty status
The employee receives a special monetary bonus upon condonation of the service interruption gap
The past service is protected and counted for qualifying service, but the 2-day break itself does not count
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 28 of the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 2021 (Condonation of interruption in service):
1. In the absence of a specific indication to the contrary in the service book, an interruption between two spells of government service rendered by a government servant is treated as automatically condoned, and the pre-interruption service is treated as qualifying service (except where the interruption was caused by resignation, dismissal, or removal from service).
2. However, the rule explicitly mandates that the period of interruption itself shall under no circumstances count as qualifying service.
Therefore, the formal condonation of a break prevents the forfeiture of valuable past service, ensuring that all prior service counts towards the employee's pension and gratuity calculations, but the gap days themselves (here, 2 days) are omitted from the total qualifying service.
questions.explanation_hindi:
केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (पेंशन) नियम, 2021 के नियम 28 (सेवा में व्यवधान की माफी / Condonation of interruption in service) के अनुसार:
1. सेवा पुस्तिका में इसके विपरीत कोई विशिष्ट प्रविष्टि न होने पर, दो सरकारी सेवाओं के बीच के अंतराल/व्यवधान को स्वतः माफ माना जाता है और व्यवधान से पूर्व की गई सेवा को पेंशन के लिए अर्हक सेवा (Qualifying Service) माना जाता है (बशर्ते व्यवधान त्यागपत्र, बर्खास्तगी या सेवा से हटाए जाने के कारण न हुआ हो)।
2. नियम में यह स्पष्ट रूप से निर्धारित है कि व्यवधान की वह अवधि (जैसे यहां 2 दिन) किसी भी परिस्थिति में अर्हक सेवा के रूप में नहीं गिनी जाएगी।
अतः व्यवधान की माफी पूर्व सेवा को जब्त (forfeit) होने से बचाती है, परंतु स्वयं व्यवधान के दिनों को सेवा काल में नहीं जोड़ा जाता।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Past service is protected for qualifying service, but the 2-day break itself does not count.

The previous service counts toward total qualifying service for pension, although the actual days comprising the interruption gap itself do not count as active qualifying service.

questions.question_english: When distinguishing between the Old Pension Scheme (OPS) and the National Pension System (NPS), which of the following features is exclusively characteristic of the NPS?
options_english: The pension amount is explicitly indexed against inflation through biannual Dearness Relief revisions.
The employee makes zero monthly contribution from their salary towards their core pension corpus.
The final retirement corpus and annuity are determined by market-linked investment returns based on chosen asset allocations.
The scheme permits unlimited non-refundable advances for residential house construction without any recovery mechanism.
questions.explanation_english:
A defining structural feature distinguishing the National Pension System (NPS) from the Old Pension Scheme (OPS) is that retirement benefits in NPS are fundamentally market-linked.

Key comparative dimensions under Central Civil Services Rules:
1. Defined Benefit vs. Defined Contribution: OPS (governed by the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021 / 1972) is a Defined Benefit (DB) pension scheme. The pensioner's entitlement is statutorily fixed at 50% of the last pay drawn or average emoluments of the preceding 10 months, backed fully by the Consolidated Fund of India with zero market volatility risk.
2. Defined Contribution Architecture in NPS: NPS (governed by PFRDA Act, 2013 and CCS (Implementation of NPS) Rules, 2021) is a Defined Contribution (DC) system. The monthly contributions (10% employee + 14% government) are pooled into the subscriber's Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) and invested by Pension Fund Managers across equities (Scheme E), corporate bonds (Scheme C), and government securities (Scheme G). The final accumulated corpus and resulting monthly annuity are entirely dependent on Net Asset Values (NAV) and market returns.
3. Inflation Protection: Under OPS, Dearness Relief (DR) is automatically revised twice every year (in January and July) to insulate pensions from inflation. In contrast, standard annuities purchased under NPS do not automatically feature statutory dearness relief unless a specific increasing-rate commercial annuity product is contracted.
4. Administrative Responsibility: The Head of Office (HoO) and Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) under NPS are responsible for timely deduction and uploading of contributions to the Trustee Bank / CRA to prevent loss of compounding returns for employees.
questions.explanation_hindi:
पुरानी पेंशन योजना (OPS) और राष्ट्रीय पेंशन प्रणाली (NPS) के बीच सबसे बुनियादी अंतर यह है कि NPS में सेवानिवृत्ति लाभ पूरी तरह बाजार-आधारित प्रतिफल (Market-linked returns) पर निर्भर करते हैं।

केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा नियमों के तहत प्रमुख तुलनात्मक बिंदु:
1. परिभाषित लाभ (Defined Benefit) बनाम परिभाषित अंशदान (Defined Contribution): OPS (जो सीसीएस (पेंशन) नियम, 2021/1972 द्वारा शासित है) एक 'परिभाषित लाभ' योजना है। इसमें पेंशनभोगी की मासिक पेंशन अंतिम आहरित वेतन या अंतिम 10 महीनों की औसत उपलब्धियों के 50% पर संहिताबद्ध होती है और भारत की संचित निधि से प्रदान की जाती है। इसमें बाजार के उतार-चढ़ाव का कोई जोखिम नहीं होता।
2. NPS की संरचना: NPS (PFRDA अधिनियम, 2013 और सीसीएस (NPS का क्रियान्वयन) नियम, 2021 द्वारा शासित) एक 'परिभाषित अंशदान' प्रणाली है। इसमें मासिक अंशदान (10% कर्मचारी + 14% सरकार) प्रान (PRAN) में जमा होता है और पेंशन फंड प्रबंधकों (PFMs) द्वारा इक्विटी (स्कीम E), कॉर्पोरेट बॉन्ड (स्कीम C) और सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों (स्कीम G) में निवेश किया जाता है। अंतिम संचित कोष और वार्षिकी पूरी तरह से बाजार के प्रतिफल (NAV) पर निर्भर करती है।
3. महंगाई से सुरक्षा: OPS में वर्ष में दो बार (जनवरी और जुलाई) महंगाई राहत (DR) का लाभ मिलता है, जबकि NPS के तहत खरीदी गई वार्षिकी में यह स्वतः प्राप्त नहीं होता।
4. कार्यालयाध्यक्ष (HoO) / DDO का दायित्व: NPS के तहत DDO का दायित्व है कि वह मासिक अंशदान समय पर ट्रस्टी बैंक को प्रेषित करे ताकि चक्रवृद्धि लाभ में कोई नुकसान न हो।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) The final retirement corpus is subject to market-linked returns based on chosen investment patterns.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A distinct characteristic exclusive to the National Pension System is that accumulated retirement funds are invested in market instruments including government securities, corporate bonds, and equity. Consequently, the final accumulated corpus and post-retirement annuity values are directly determined by market-linked investment returns rather than guaranteed fixed returns or predefined statutory formulas.

questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 10 of the Central Civil Services (Implementation of National Pension System) Rules, 2021 (notified by DoPPW) and relevant Department of Expenditure guidelines:
1. Option for Benefit: Every Central Government employee appointed on or after 01.01.2004 covered under NPS must exercise an option in Form 1 at the time of joining service. In the event of death in service or discharge on invalidation/disability, benefits may be availed under the CCS (Pension) Rules or CCS (Extraordinary Pension) Rules, or as per the NPS regulations.
2. Default/Family Right: If the government servant died without exercising the option, or if the option exercised was for CCS rules, the eligible family is given the right to opt for benefits under the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021 (i.e., monthly Family Pension and Death Gratuity).
3. Adjustment of Corpus: When Family Pension under CCS rules is sanctioned to the family, the accumulated pension wealth in the subscriber's Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) corresponding to the government contribution and returns thereon is credited back to the Government account (Consolidated Fund of India). The employee's own contribution and returns thereon are refunded to the family/nominee in lump sum.

questions.question_english: Under the NPS architecture, the function of maintaining records, administration, and customer service for all subscribers is performed by the:
options_english: Central Recordkeeping Agency
Registered Pension Fund Managers (PFMs)
Designated NPS Trustee Bank

questions.explanation_english:
Under the National Pension System (NPS) operational architecture established by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) Act, 2013, the Central Recordkeeping Agency (CRA) functions as the central operational backbone. CRAs (such as Protean e-Gov Technologies / formerly NSDL, KFin Technologies, and CAMS) are registered institutions responsible for:
1. Subscriber onboarding, data administration, and centralized database maintenance.
2. Generation and issuance of the unique 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) and PRAN cards.
3. Processing transaction instructions (contributions, allocation choices, portfolio switches, withdrawals).
4. Operating customer servicing channels, web portals, call centres, and the Central Grievance Management System (CGMS).

In contrast, Pension Fund Managers (PFMs) manage investment portfolios, the Trustee Bank oversees banking clearing operations, and Annuity Service Providers (ASPs) deliver monthly pensions after superannuation.
questions.explanation_hindi:
पेंशन निधि विनियामक और विकास प्राधिकरण (PFRDA) अधिनियम, 2013 के तहत स्थापित राष्ट्रीय पेंशन प्रणाली (NPS) के संस्थागत ढांचे में, केंद्रीय अभिलेखपाल अभिकरण (CRA) केंद्रीय रीढ़ के रूप में कार्य करता है। वर्तमान में प्रोटियन (पूर्व में NSDL), केफिनटेक और कैम्स जैसी संस्थाएं CRA के रूप में कार्य करती हैं। CRA के प्रमुख दायित्व निम्नलिखित हैं:
1. अभिदाता पंजीकरण, डेटाबेस का केंद्रीकृत रख-रखाव और खाता प्रशासन।
2. प्रत्येक अभिदाता के लिए 12-अंकीय विशिष्ट स्थायी सेवानिवृत्ति खाता संख्या (PRAN) और प्रान कार्ड जारी करना।

questions.explanation_english:
‘Bhavishya’ is an end-to-end online Pension Sanction and Payment Tracking System designed, implemented, and managed by the Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare (DoP&PW), Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, Government of India:

1. Workflow Digitization: It automates the entire processing of pension cases, starting from the retiring employee who fills Forms 6, 7, and 8 online 8 months before superannuation, to the Head of Office (HoO), Pay and Accounts Office (PAO), and the Central Pension Accounting Office (CPAO).
2. Real-time Transparency: It allows the retiring employee and administration to track the real-time status of the pension file, alerting stakeholders about upcoming deadlines to eliminate administrative delays.
3. Electronic PPO & DigiLocker: Bhavishya generates an electronic Pension Payment Order (e-PPO) and integrates directly with DigiLocker, ensuring that pensioners receive their retirement gratuity and first pension on the very date of superannuation.
4. Seamless Banking Integration: It interfaces with CPAO's PARAS portal and banks' CPPC systems for electronic pension disbursement.

The employee must convert the accumulated GPF balance into NPS Tier-I to access housing withdrawal funds
Withdrawal of up to 90% of the balance at credit is permitted within 12 months before retirement without assigning any reason
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 15(1)(C) of the General Provident Fund (Central Services) Rules, 1960 and the liberalized provisions issued vide Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare (DoP&PW) OM dated 07.03.2017, a subscriber is permitted to make a non-refundable GPF withdrawal of up to ninety percent (90%) of the accumulated balance standing at their credit at any time within twelve (12) months prior to the date of retirement on superannuation. Importantly, this 90% withdrawal is allowed without assigning any specific reason or requiring documentary justification. 100% final withdrawal and account closure occurs only upon actual retirement (Rule 34), and monthly subscriptions are compulsorily stopped three months prior to the superannuation date. Thus, six months before retirement, the employee can withdraw up to 90% of their balance.
questions.explanation_hindi: सामान्य भविष्य निधि (केंद्रीय सेवाएं) नियम, 1960 के नियम 15(1)(C) तथा कार्मिक, लोक शिकायत एवं पेंशन मंत्रालय (DoP&PW) के कार्यालय ज्ञापन दिनांक 07.03.2017 के अनुसार, किसी भी अभिदाता को अपनी अधिवर्षिता सेवानिवृत्ति की तिथि से 12 महीने के भीतर बिना कोई विशेष कारण बताए या बिना कोई दस्तावेज प्रस्तुत किए, अपने जीपीएफ खाते में जमा राशि का 90% तक अप्रतिदेय (non-refundable) रूप से निकालने की अनुमति है। संपूर्ण 100% शेष राशि का अंतिम निपटान एवं खाता बंद केवल सेवानिवृत्ति की वास्तविक तिथि पर या उसके बाद ही होता है (सेवानिवृत्ति से तीन माह पूर्व जीपीएफ कटौती अनिवार्यतः रोक दी जाती है)। अतः सेवानिवृत्ति से छह माह पूर्व कर्मचारी अपने जीपीएफ बैलेंस का अधिकतम 90% निकाल सकता है।

questions.explanation_english:
On August 24, 2024, the Union Cabinet approved the Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) for Central Government employees, which provides several assured pillars:
1. Assured Pension: Under Pillar 1 of UPS, an employee who has completed a minimum qualifying service of 25 years is guaranteed an Assured Pension equal to 50% of the average basic pay drawn during the last 12 months prior to superannuation.
2. Proportionate Pension: For employees with qualifying service between 10 years and 25 years, the assured pension is calculated on a proportionate basis.
3. Dearness Relief Indexation: Like the Old Pension Scheme (OPS), the assured pension under UPS is indexed to inflation and Dearness Relief (DR) is provided as applicable to central government pensioners.

questions.explanation_english: Under PFRDA regulations governing National Pension System (NPS) Tier-I accounts, subscribers are required to deposit a minimum statutory contribution (prescribed at ₹1,000 per financial year in the voluntary/citizen model) to keep the account active. If a subscriber fails to deposit the mandatory minimum contribution within a financial year, the Tier-I PRAN account is marked as 'Frozen' or 'Inactive' in the Central Recordkeeping Agency (CRA) system. While frozen, the existing corpus continues to earn market-linked returns based on NAV, but the subscriber cannot perform transactions or withdraw funds. To unfreeze and reactivate the account, the subscriber must deposit the overdue minimum contribution along with the prescribed reactivation penalty fee. Accumulated funds are never forfeited to the government. Hence, option C is correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
पेंशन निधि विनियामक और विकास प्राधिकरण (PFRDA) के दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार, NPS टियर-I खाते को सक्रिय बनाए रखने के लिए प्रत्येक वित्तीय वर्ष में न्यूनतम निर्धारित अंशदान (कम से कम ₹1,000 प्रति वर्ष) जमा करना अनिवार्य होता है।
यदि कोई अभिदाता किसी वित्तीय वर्ष में यह न्यूनतम राशि जमा नहीं करता है, तो CRA प्रणाली द्वारा उसके टियर-I खाते को 'फ्रीज' (Frozen) या निष्क्रिय घोषित कर दिया जाता है।
खाता फ्रीज होने पर भी पूर्व में जमा राशि पर NAV के अनुसार रिटर्न मिलता रहता है, परंतु खाताधारक कोई नया लेन-देन या निकासी नहीं कर सकता। खाते को पुनः सक्रिय (Unfreeze) कराने के लिए अभिदाता को न्यूनतम अंशदान के साथ निर्धारित नाममात्र का जुर्माना/अनफ्रीजिंग शुल्क अदा करना पड़ता है। इसमें धनराशि जब्त नहीं होती। अतः सही उत्तर C है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Account is frozen until reactivated by paying penalty and minimum contribution.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the role of the Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) in NPS:
I. The DDO is responsible for deducting the employee’s contribution of 10% from the monthly salary.
II. The DDO is responsible for generating the PRAN independently without routing through PAO/CRA.
III. The DDO prepares the bill for the government’s matching contribution of 14%.
IV. The DDO must upload the subscriber contribution file to the CRA system.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
I, III, and IV
II, III, and IV
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english:
Under standard operational guidelines of the National Pension System (NPS) and Central Civil Accounts Service procedures:
- Statement I is correct: The DDO is statutorily mandated to deduct 10% of (Basic Pay + DA) as the employee's monthly contribution from their salary bill.
- Statement II is incorrect: The DDO cannot generate the Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) independently. The DDO verifies the subscriber registration form (CSRF) and forwards it to the Nodal Office / Pay and Accounts Office (PAO). The PAO authorizes and submits the request to the Central Recordkeeping Agency (CRA), which registers the subscriber and generates the PRAN.
- Statement III is correct: As per Ministry of Finance notification (effective from 01.04.2019), the central government matching contribution is 14% of (Basic Pay + DA). The DDO prepares the bill for this 14% government contribution.
- Statement IV is correct: The DDO/PAO is responsible for preparing and uploading the Subscriber Contribution File (SCF) through the CRA system to ensure timely credit into the subscriber's PRAN.
Therefore, statements I, III, and IV are correct, while statement II is incorrect. Hence, option B is correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
राष्ट्रीय पेंशन प्रणाली (NPS) की परिचालन कार्यप्रणाली तथा लेखा प्रक्रियाओं के अनुसार:
- कथन I सही है: DDO प्रत्येक माह कर्मचारी के वेतन से 10% (मूल वेतन + DA) अनिवार्य अंशदान की कटौती करने के लिए उत्तरदायी होता है।
- कथन II गलत है: DDO स्वतंत्र रूप से PRAN (स्थायी सेवानिवृत्ति खाता संख्या) सृजित नहीं कर सकता। DDO केवल अभिदाता के पंजीकरण प्रपत्र को सत्यापित कर नोडल कार्यालय/वेतन एवं लेखा कार्यालय (PAO) को भेजता है, जो इसे केंद्रीय रिकॉर्डकीपिंग एजेंसी (CRA) को प्रेषित करता है, जहाँ से PRAN जारी होता है।
- कथन III सही है: 1 अप्रैल 2019 से प्रभावी केंद्र सरकार के नियमों के अनुसार सरकार का समकक्ष अंशदान 14% है, जिसका बिल DDO द्वारा तैयार किया जाता है।
- कथन IV सही है: DDO/नोडल कार्यालय द्वारा अभिदाता अंशदान फाइल (SCF) को CRA सिस्टम पर अपलोड किया जाता है ताकि धनराशि अभिदाता के खाते में समय पर जमा हो सके।
अतः कथन I, III और IV सही हैं, जबकि कथन II गलत है। सही उत्तर B है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, III, and IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Drawing and Disbursing Officer deducts ten percent subscriber contribution, prepares the matching fourteen percent government contribution bill, and uploads contribution details to the CRA system. However, PRAN generation is not done independently by the DDO, as it must be processed and registered through the PAO and CRA.

questions.question_english: Which of the following is NOT a recognized statutory class of pension under the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 2021?
options_english: Merit Pension
Superannuation Pension
Retiring Pension
Compensation Pension
questions.explanation_english:
Under Chapters V and VI of the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 2021, the statutory categories of pensions recognized by the Government of India are strictly enumerated:
1. Superannuation Pension (Rule 34) – granted upon reaching the age of superannuation (60 years).
2. Retiring Pension (Rule 35) – granted on voluntary retirement or retirement under FR 56(j)/(k).
3. Invalid Pension (Rule 39) – granted on permanent medical incapacitation.
4. Compensation Pension (Rule 40) – granted upon discharge owing to the abolition of a permanent post.
5. Compulsory Retirement Pension (Rule 41) – imposed as a disciplinary penalty.
6. Compassionate Allowance (Rule 42) – granted to dismissed or removed employees in deserving cases.
There is NO statutory category or provision known as 'Merit Pension' in the Central Civil Services rules.
questions.explanation_hindi:
केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (पेंशन) नियम, 2021 के अध्याय V एवं VI के अंतर्गत भारत सरकार द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त सांविधिक पेंशन की श्रेणियां निम्नलिखित हैं:
1. अधिवर्षिता पेंशन (Superannuation Pension - नियम 34): 60 वर्ष की आयु पूर्ण करने पर।
2. सेवानिवृत्ति पेंशन (Retiring Pension - नियम 35): स्वैच्छिक या समय-पूर्व सेवानिवृत्ति पर।
3. अशक्तता पेंशन (Invalid Pension - नियम 39): चिकित्सीय रूप से स्थायी अयोग्य घोषित होने पर।
4. क्षतिपूर्ति पेंशन (Compensation Pension - नियम 40): स्थायी पद समाप्त होने पर।
5. अनिवार्य सेवानिवृत्ति पेंशन (Compulsory Retirement Pension - नियम 41): अनुशासनात्मक दंड के रूप में।
6. अनुकंपा भत्ता (Compassionate Allowance - नियम 42): बर्खास्त या हटाए गए कर्मचारियों के लिए।
केंद्रीय सेवा नियमों में 'योग्यता पेंशन' (Merit Pension) नाम की कोई पेंशन श्रेणी या प्रावधान अस्तित्व में नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Merit Pension

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, recognized categories of pension include Superannuation Pension, Retiring Pension, Invalid Pension, Compensation Pension, and Extraordinary Pension. “Merit Pension” is not a defined or recognized category of pensionary benefit within the statutory framework of the Old Pension Scheme or central service rules.
